blurb.en: A Series is one column whose values carry labels; a DataFrame is a table of such columns sharing the same labels. Look values up by label and by position, add a column, and check what type each thing is.
blurb.zh: Series 是一列带标签的值；DataFrame 是共用同一套标签的若干列拼成的表。按标签取、按位置取，加一列，再看清每样东西是什么类型。

en: pandas is a library for tables of data. It is not part of Python itself: install it with pip install pandas, and by convention it is imported as pd. It has two building blocks. A Series is one column of values in which every value has a label; the labels together are called the index. A DataFrame is a table whose columns are Series sharing one index.

marks has the labels a, b and c. Square brackets with a label, or .loc with a label, look a value up by its label; .iloc looks it up by position, counting from 0 as a list does. All three reach the same value here, 58, because label b also sits in position 1. Once rows have been filtered or sorted, labels and positions stop lining up, and writing .loc or .iloc says plainly which one you mean.

Arithmetic between two Series lines the values up by label, not by position. bonus only has the labels a and c, so marks + bonus gives 77 for a and 70 for c, and for b, where one side has nothing, it gives NaN (not a number), pandas' mark for a missing value. NaN is a float, so the whole result becomes float64: 77.0, NaN, 70.0.

build_table makes a DataFrame from a dictionary: each key becomes a column name and each list becomes that column. After the passed column has been added the table has shape (3, 4): three rows, four columns. dtypes gives the type of each column: the text columns name and form are object, score is int64 and passed is bool.

Assigning to a column name that does not exist yet adds a column. Comparing the whole score column with the pass mark compares every score at once and gives a column of True / False, with no loop written: Ada and Cal passed, Ben did not.

One column name inside the square brackets gives a Series; a list of column names inside the square brackets gives a DataFrame, even when the list holds just one name. The two type names printed are Series and DataFrame. Many mistakes with pandas come from expecting one of these and getting the other.

The mean of the scores is 65.0, but its type is float64, a numpy number, not a Python float. Printed on its own it looks the same; put inside a list and printed, numpy 2 shows it as np.float64(65.0). That is why the program turns it into a float with float() before rounding and printing, and why the other programs on this page return plain Python values. More on numpy numbers on the 「NumPy Basics」 page.
zh: pandas 是处理数据表的库。它不是 Python 自带的：用 pip install pandas 安装，按惯例导入成 pd。它有两块积木。Series 是一列值，每个值都带一个标签，这些标签合起来叫索引（index）。DataFrame 是一张表，它的每一列都是 Series，共用同一套索引。
marks 的标签是 a、b、c。方括号里写标签、或者用 .loc 写标签，都是按标签取值；.iloc 是按位置取，和列表一样从 0 数。这里三种写法取到的是同一个值 58，因为标签 b 恰好也在位置 1。等到行被筛选、排序过之后，标签和位置就对不上了，写明 .loc 还是 .iloc，就说清了你指的是哪一个。
两个 Series 之间做算术，是按标签对齐，不是按位置。bonus 只有标签 a 和 c，所以 marks + bonus 在 a 上得 77、在 c 上得 70；在 b 上一边没有值，得到 NaN（not a number），这是 pandas 表示「缺失」的记号。NaN 是浮点数，所以整个结果变成 float64：77.0、NaN、70.0。
build_table 用一个字典建 DataFrame：每个键成为一个列名，每个列表成为那一列。加上 passed 那一列之后，表的 shape 是 (3, 4)：三行、四列。dtypes 给出每一列的类型：文字列 name 和 form 是 object，score 是 int64，passed 是 bool。
给一个还不存在的列名赋值，就是加一列。拿整列分数和及格线比较，会一次比完每个分数，得到一整列 True / False，一个循环都不用写：Ada 和 Cal 及格，Ben 没有。
方括号里放一个列名，得到的是 Series；方括号里放一个列名的列表，得到的是 DataFrame——哪怕列表里只有一个名字。打印出来的两个类型名分别是 Series 和 DataFrame。用 pandas 时许多错误，都出在想要其中一种、拿到的却是另一种。
分数的均值是 65.0，但它的类型是 float64——numpy 的数，不是 Python 的 float。单独打印看不出区别；放进列表再打印，numpy 2 会显示成 np.float64(65.0)。所以程序先用 float() 转成 Python 的 float 再取整、打印，本页其余程序的函数也都返回 Python 自己的值。numpy 的数详见「NumPy 基础」页。

lineNotes.zh: 只有两个标签：下面那次相加里，b 找不到对应的值。

lineNotes.zh: 文字列显示为 object，整数是 int64，True / False 是 bool。

lineNotes.en: float() first: a plain Python float, not a numpy float64.
lineNotes.zh: 先 float()：变成 Python 自己的 float，而不是 numpy 的 float64。

title.en: Read a CSV File and Look Inside
title.zh: 读进 CSV 文件，看看里面有什么

blurb.en: One call reads a whole CSV file into a DataFrame. Then ask it how big it is, what type each column has, what the first rows look like, and what its numbers add up to.
blurb.zh: 一次调用把整个 CSV 文件读成 DataFrame。然后问它：有多大、每列是什么类型、前几行长什么样、数字合起来是什么情况。

en: read_csv reads a whole CSV file into a DataFrame in one call: the first line of the file becomes the column names and every later line becomes a row. Compared with reading it through the csv module (see 「Files & Exceptions」), the columns come back with types: score and homework are whole numbers (int64) straight away, with no int() on every value, while the text columns name and form are object.

shape is a pair (rows, columns): 6 rows and 4 columns here, which describe_size turns into the sentence 6 rows, 4 columns. head shows only the first few rows (five if you give no number) - a quick look at a file that may run to thousands of lines. The program asks for three, so it shows Ada, Ben and Cal with their row labels 0, 1 and 2.

describe() summarises every numeric column in one table: count, mean, std (the standard deviation), min, the quartiles 25%, 50% and 75%, and max. The scores run from 49 to 81 with a mean of about 65.83; the homework marks run from 5 to 9. This page only reads that table; what the numbers mean is statistics.

idxmax() gives the label of the row holding the largest score, and .loc with that label and a column name picks out a single cell: the top score is Dee's 81. Adding up the homework column gives 43. Each of these is one line, where the same questions asked of a list of dictionaries would each need a loop.
To run this in PyCharm you need the data file too: make a folder called _fixtures next to the program and put a file pupils.csv in it. It has these seven lines, one per paragraph below:
name,form,score,homework
The path _fixtures/pupils.csv is relative, so it is looked up from the folder the program is run in, which is PyCharm's working directory, normally the program's own folder.
zh: read_csv 一次调用就把整个 CSV 文件读成 DataFrame：文件第一行成为列名，之后每一行成为一行数据。和用 csv 模块读（见「文件与异常」）相比，读回来的列带着类型：score 和 homework 直接就是整数（int64），不用对每个值调 int()；文字列 name 和 form 是 object。
shape 是一个二元组（行数, 列数）：这里是 6 行 4 列，describe_size 把它说成一句 6 rows, 4 columns。head 只显示前几行（不给数字就是五行）——对一个可能有几千行的文件先瞄一眼。程序要的是三行，所以显示 Ada、Ben、Cal，行标签是 0、1、2。
describe() 用一张表概括每一个数值列：count（个数）、mean（均值）、std（标准差）、min、四分位数 25%、50%、75%，以及 max。分数从 49 到 81，均值约 65.83；作业分从 5 到 9。本页只读这张表；这些数说明什么，是统计的事。
idxmax() 给出分数最大的那一行的标签，.loc 用这个标签加一个列名取出单独一格：最高分是 Dee 的 81。把 homework 一列加起来是 43。这几件事各是一行；换成字典列表，每一件都得写一个循环。
要在 PyCharm 里跑，还得有这份数据文件：在程序旁边建一个叫 _fixtures 的文件夹，里面放 pupils.csv，内容就是下面七行，一段一行：
name,form,score,homework
_fixtures/pupils.csv 是相对路径，从「程序在哪个文件夹里运行」开始找，也就是 PyCharm 的工作目录，通常就是程序自己所在的文件夹。

lineNotes.zh: 最高分所在行的标签，不是分数本身。

title.en: Filter Rows with a Boolean Mask

blurb.en: Compare a column with a value to get a column of True / False, then use it to keep only the rows you want. Two conditions are joined with &, not and.
blurb.zh: 拿一列和一个值比较，得到一列 True / False，再用它只留下想要的行。两个条件用 & 连，不用 and。

en: Comparing a column with a value gives a mask: a column of True / False with one entry per row. Putting the mask inside the DataFrame's square brackets keeps the rows marked True and drops the rest. With a pass mark of 60 the mask is True, False, True, True, False, True, so Ada, Cal, Dee and Fay stay - and they keep their original row labels 0, 2, 3 and 5; the rows are not renumbered.

Conditions are combined with & (and), | (or) and ~ (not), each comparison in its own round brackets. The brackets matter because & binds more tightly than >= and ==: without them Python would try to work out threshold & the form column first, and the line fails.

Why not and? and asks whether the thing on its left is true as a whole, and a column of many True / False values has no single answer - pandas refuses to guess and raises a ValueError, which the demo catches and prints by name. & works element by element instead: in each row, both sides must be True.

passed_in_form puts it together: the names of the pupils in one form with at least the threshold. In 12B with 60 it gives Dee and Fay. In 12A with 65 it gives Ada and Cal - Cal's 65 is exactly on the line and counts, because the test is greater than or equal. Nobody in 12A reaches 90, so that call gives an empty list. ~ flips every value of the mask, which gives the rows that failed: Ben and Eve.

.tolist() turns the chosen column into an ordinary Python list, so the function returns plain strings rather than a pandas Series. The same filter written as a query string is in 「Filter Rows with a Query String」.
zh: 拿一列和一个值比较，得到的是一个掩码：一列 True / False，每行一个。把掩码放进 DataFrame 的方括号里，就留下标 True 的行、丢掉其余的。及格线 60 时，掩码是 True、False、True、True、False、True，于是留下 Ada、Cal、Dee、Fay——它们保留原来的行标签 0、2、3、5，不会重新编号。
组合条件用 &（且）、|（或）、~（非），每个比较各套一层圆括号。圆括号要紧，因为 & 比 >= 和 == 结合得更紧：不加括号，Python 会先去算 threshold & form 那一列，这一行就出错。
为什么不用 and？and 要问的是它左边那个东西「整体」是真是假，而一列许多个 True / False 没有唯一的答案——pandas 不肯替你猜，抛出 ValueError，演示块接住它、只打印名字。& 则是逐个元素地算：每一行里，两边都得是 True。
passed_in_form 把这些拼起来：某个班里分数不低于门槛的学生名字。12B、门槛 60，得到 Dee 和 Fay。12A、门槛 65，得到 Ada 和 Cal——Cal 的 65 恰好压线，也算，因为判的是「大于或等于」。12A 没有人到 90，那次调用得到空列表。~ 把掩码的每个值翻过来，得到没过线的行：Ben 和 Eve。
.tolist() 把挑出来的那一列转成普通的 Python 列表，所以函数返回的是一串字符串，而不是 pandas 的 Series。同样的筛选写成 query 字符串，见「用 query 字符串筛选行」。

lineNotes.en: One comparison, the whole column: a Series of True / False.
lineNotes.zh: 一次比较，整列都比：得到一个 True / False 的 Series。

lineNotes.en: and cannot turn a whole column into one True or False, so this raises ValueError.
lineNotes.zh: and 没法把一整列变成一个 True 或 False，所以这里抛 ValueError。

lineNotes.en: ~ is not, applied to every row.
lineNotes.zh: ~ 是「非」，逐行作用。

2  Cal  12A     65
3  Dee  12B     81
5  Fay  12B     70

title.en: Filter Rows with a Query String
title.zh: 用 query 字符串筛选行

blurb.en: Write the condition as a string and let query find the columns in it. Python variables come in with @, and and / or work as words.
blurb.zh: 把条件写成一个字符串，让 query 自己在里面找列名。Python 变量用 @ 带进去，and / or 照字面写就行。

en: query takes the condition as a string and looks the column names up inside it for you, so a condition on score needs no df[...] around the column. Inside the string you can write and, or and not, and they work row by row, because pandas reads the string itself - it is not Python's own and. A text value is quoted inside the string: single quotes inside a double-quoted string, as in the test for form 12B, which keeps Ben, Dee and Fay.

A Python variable is brought into the string with @: @cut means the value of the variable cut, not a column called cut. With cut at 70 the names are Ada, Dee and Fay. passed_in_form uses @ for both of its parameters, so the same string works for any threshold and any form.

The results match the mask version exactly: 12B with 60 gives Dee and Fay; 12A with 65 gives Ada and Cal, with Cal's 65 on the line; 12A with 90 gives an empty list. The last line uses or: scores below 60, or anyone in 12A, which is Ada, Ben, Cal and Eve.

Compare with 「Filter Rows with a Boolean Mask」: the mask writes each condition as a comparison in round brackets joined by &, while query reads more like a sentence. query is handy for a long condition; a mask is handier when the condition is built up step by step in code. One cost of query: a misspelt column name inside the string is only found when that line runs.
zh: query 把条件当作一个字符串来收，并替你在字符串里找列名，所以对 score 的条件不用再套 df[...]。字符串里可以写 and、or、not，而且是逐行起作用，因为这个字符串由 pandas 自己去读——它不是 Python 自己的 and。文字值在字符串里要加引号：双引号字符串里用单引号，就像筛 12B 班那一句，留下 Ben、Dee、Fay。
Python 变量用 @ 带进字符串：@cut 指变量 cut 的值，不是一个叫 cut 的列。cut 为 70 时，名字是 Ada、Dee、Fay。passed_in_form 的两个形参都用 @ 带进去，所以同一个字符串对任何门槛、任何班都适用。
结果和掩码写法完全一样：12B、60 得到 Dee 和 Fay；12A、65 得到 Ada 和 Cal，Cal 的 65 压线；12A、90 得到空列表。最后一行用 or：分数低于 60，或者在 12A 班，也就是 Ada、Ben、Cal、Eve。
和「用布尔掩码筛选行」对照：掩码把每个条件写成套在圆括号里的比较、用 & 连起来；query 读起来更像一句话。条件长时 query 顺手；条件要在代码里一步步拼出来时，掩码顺手。query 的一个代价：字符串里的列名拼错了，要等这一行真的跑起来才发现。

lineNotes.en: Single quotes inside a double-quoted string: 12B is a text value.
lineNotes.zh: 双引号字符串里的单引号：12B 是一个文字值。

lineNotes.en: An ordinary Python variable; the next line reaches it with @.
lineNotes.zh: 一个普通的 Python 变量；下一行用 @ 引用它。

title.zh: 用 groupby 按组求均值

blurb.en: Split the rows by form, average each part, and put the answers together - one chain with groupby. The answer is a Series whose index is the group names.
blurb.zh: 按班级把行分开、每份求均值、再把答案拼起来——groupby 一条链写完。答案是一个 Series，索引就是各组的名字。

en: Grouping means three steps: split the rows by the value of one column, do a calculation on each part, and combine the answers. Done by hand it takes a dictionary of lists and a loop (see 「Dictionaries & Sets」); groupby does all three in one chain.

Grouping by form splits the rows into 12A, 12B and 13A. Choosing the score column and averaging gives one number per form: 62.0 for 12A, about 69.67 for 12B and 77.0 for 13A. The answer is a Series whose index is the group names, in sorted order.

agg asks for several results at once. Given the list mean and count, it returns a small table with one row per form and one column per result: 12A and 12B have 3 pupils each, 13A only 1 - worth knowing before you trust an average. Looking up row 12B, column count, gives 3.

form_means turns the answer into a plain dictionary. items() on a Series gives (index, value) pairs, just as it gives (key, value) pairs on a dictionary, and walking a Series like this hands back plain Python numbers - unlike looking a single value up, such as the 12B count above, which gives a numpy number. So round(..., 9) applies straight away and keeps nine decimal places: 69.666... becomes 69.666666667. With only Ada and Ben, each form has one pupil and the averages are simply 72.0 and 58.0.
The same averages come out of pivot_table in 「Average per Group with pivot_table」, as a table instead of a single column.
zh: 分组是三步：按某一列的值把行分开、对每一份做计算、再把答案合起来。手工做要一个「列表的字典」加一个循环（见「字典与集合」）；groupby 一条链把三步都做完。
按 form 分组，把行分成 12A、12B、13A 三份。取出 score 这一列求均值，每个班得到一个数：12A 是 62.0，12B 约 69.67，13A 是 77.0。答案是一个 Series，索引是各组的名字，按顺序排好。
agg 一次要好几个结果。给它 mean 和 count 组成的列表，它返回一张小表：每个班一行、每个结果一列。12A 和 12B 各有 3 人，13A 只有 1 人——信一个均值之前，这个数值得先看一眼。取 12B 那一行、count 那一列，得到 3。

form_means 把答案转成普通的字典。Series 的 items() 给出（索引, 值）对，正如字典的 items() 给出（键, 值）对；这样走一遍 Series，拿到的是 Python 自己的数——不像单独取一个值（比如上面取 12B 的人数）拿到的是 numpy 的数。所以可以直接 round(…, 9)，保留九位小数：69.666… 成了 69.666666667。只有 Ada 和 Ben 时，每个班只有一人，均值就是 72.0 和 58.0。
同样的均值也能用 pivot_table 算出来，见「用 pivot_table 按组求均值」——得到的是一张表，而不是一列。

lineNotes.en: Two results per group: the average and how many rows it came from.
lineNotes.zh: 每组两个结果：均值，以及它来自几行。

lineNotes.en: mean is already a plain Python float here; round keeps the last digits steady.
lineNotes.zh: 这里的 mean 已经是 Python 自己的 float；round 让末几位稳定。

title.zh: 用 pivot_table 按组求均值

blurb.en: pivot_table builds a summary table from three choices: what the rows are, which column to summarise, and how. Same numbers as groupby, different shape.
blurb.zh: pivot_table 用三个选择搭出一张汇总表：行是什么、汇总哪一列、怎么汇总。数和 groupby 一样，形状不一样。

en: pivot_table builds a summary table from three keyword arguments. index names the column whose values become the rows, values names the column to summarise, and aggfunc names how to summarise it - by name, as a string. The numbers match 「Average per Group with groupby」: 62.0 for 12A, about 69.67 for 12B and 77.0 for 13A.

The shape is different. The groupby answer, with one column chosen, is a Series of shape (3,). The pivot table is a DataFrame of shape (3, 1): three rows, one column called score, and the index 12A, 12B, 13A. A table is what you want when more columns will be added or it will be printed as a report; a Series is handier for a single list of numbers.

Because the result is a table, form_means first takes its one column out and then walks the (form, average) pairs with items() - the same step as in the groupby version, one level deeper. The dictionary it returns holds 62.0, 69.666666667 and 77.0; with just Ada and Ben it holds 72.0 and 58.0.

aggfunc can also be sum, count, max and so on, or a list of them, which gives one column per function. pivot_table can also take columns=, spreading the values of a second column across the top to make a two-way table - that is where it does more than groupby.
zh: pivot_table 用三个关键字实参搭出一张汇总表。index 说哪一列的值成为行，values 说汇总哪一列，aggfunc 说怎么汇总——用名字、写成字符串。数和「用 groupby 按组求均值」一样：12A 是 62.0，12B 约 69.67，13A 是 77.0。
形状不一样。groupby 取了一列之后的答案是 Series，shape 为 (3,)。透视表是 DataFrame，shape 为 (3, 1)：三行、一列（列名 score），索引是 12A、12B、13A。之后还要加列、或者要当报表打印时，要的是表；只要一串数时，Series 更顺手。
因为结果是一张表，form_means 先把它唯一的那一列取出来，再用 items() 一对一对地走（班级, 均值）——和 groupby 那个版本同一步，只是深了一层。返回的字典里是 62.0、69.666666667、77.0；只有 Ada 和 Ben 时是 72.0 和 58.0。
aggfunc 也可以是 sum、count、max 等等，或者它们组成的列表——那样每个函数得到一列。pivot_table 还能收 columns=，把第二列的值铺到表头上，做成一张二维表——这正是它比 groupby 多出来的本事。

lineNotes.en: A DataFrame with one column: shape (3, 1).
lineNotes.zh: 只有一列的 DataFrame：shape 是 (3, 1)。

lineNotes.en: The groupby answer for comparison: a Series of shape (3,).
lineNotes.zh: 拿 groupby 的答案来对照：shape 为 (3,) 的 Series。

title.en: Missing Values: Drop or Fill with the Mean
title.zh: 缺失值：丢掉，或用均值补上

blurb.en: Count the gaps, drop them, or fill each one with the mean of the readings that are there - and see why mean() skipping NaN is not the same as counting it as 0.
blurb.zh: 数一数缺口、把缺口丢掉，或者用在场读数的均值补上——再看清「mean() 跳过 NaN」和「当 0 算」为什么不一样。

en: Real data has gaps: a sensor that did not report, a pupil who was absent. A None put into a Series of floats becomes NaN, pandas' marker for a missing number; dtype="float64" makes the Series hold floats however the values were written. READINGS has six readings and two of them are missing. isna() marks each position True where the value is missing, and adding those up counts the gaps - 2 here, because True counts as 1.

dropna() throws the gaps away and keeps 12.0, 15.0, 9.0 and 14.0: six readings become four. That is fine for an average, but the positions are gone - you can no longer tell which hour each reading belongs to.

mean() skips NaN: it averages only the four readings that are there, 50 / 4 = 12.5. Counting a missing reading as 0 gives a different answer, and a wrong one: filling with 0 first gives 50 / 6, about 8.33, as if two readings really had been zero.

fillna puts a value into every gap and keeps every position. Filling with the mean of what is there gives 12.0, 12.5, 15.0, 9.0, 12.5, 14.0: every hour has a value and the average is still 12.5. For [None, 3, None] the only reading is 3, so both gaps become 3.0. If every value were missing there would be no mean to fill with, and the gaps would stay NaN.

fill_with_mean returns plain Python floats - walking a Series hands its values back as Python numbers - rounded to nine places, and never NaN. That matters when answers are compared: NaN is not equal to anything, not even to itself, so two lists that both hold NaN never compare equal. How a program turns a gap into None instead is in 「Join Two Tables: a Left Join」.
zh: 真实数据有缺口：传感器没报数、学生缺席。None 放进浮点数的 Series 会变成 NaN，这是 pandas 表示「缺一个数」的记号；dtype="float64" 让 Series 不论值是怎么写的都存成浮点数。READINGS 有六个读数，缺两个。isna() 在每个缺值的位置标 True，把它们加起来就数出了缺口——这里是 2，因为 True 算 1。
dropna() 把缺口扔掉，留下 12.0、15.0、9.0、14.0：六个读数变成四个。求均值没问题，但位置丢了——你再也说不出每个读数属于哪个钟点。
mean() 会跳过 NaN：只对在场的四个读数求均值，50 / 4 = 12.5。把缺的读数当 0 算，是另一个答案，而且是错的：先用 0 补再求均值，得到 50 / 6，约 8.33，就好像那两个读数真的是 0。
fillna 往每个缺口里放一个值，每个位置都保留。用在场读数的均值去补，得到 12.0、12.5、15.0、9.0、12.5、14.0：每个钟点都有值，均值仍是 12.5。对 [None, 3, None]，唯一的读数是 3，两个缺口都成了 3.0。要是全都缺，就没有均值可补，缺口仍是 NaN。
fill_with_mean 返回 Python 自己的 float（逐个走 Series，拿到的就是 Python 的数），保留九位小数，绝不含 NaN。这在比较答案时要紧：NaN 不等于任何东西，连它自己都不等，所以两个都含 NaN 的列表永远比不出相等。程序怎么把缺口换成 None，见「合并两张表：左连接」。

lineNotes.en: The wrong way: two zeros that were never measured drag the average down.
lineNotes.zh: 错误的做法：两个从没测过的 0 把均值拉低了。

lineNotes.en: Gaps removed: four readings left, positions lost.
lineNotes.zh: 缺口去掉：剩四个读数，位置丢了。

title.en: Join Two Tables: a Left Join

blurb.en: Line two tables up on a shared id. A left join keeps every pupil, even one with no score; an inner join keeps only the ids found in both. A missing score is handed back as None.
blurb.zh: 按共有的 id 把两张表对齐。左连接留下每一个学生，哪怕他没有分数；内连接只留两边都有的 id。缺的分数交回去时是 None。

en: Data often comes in two tables that share a key: pupils with an id and a name, and scores with an id and a score. merge lines the rows up on the shared column, and how says which rows to keep.

A left join keeps every row of the left table, in its order. Ada, Cal and Dee have scores; Ben, id 2, has none, so his score is NaN. The score for id 5 matches no pupil and is dropped. Because NaN is a float, the whole score column turns into floats - 72.0, NaN, 65.0, 81.0 - which is why join_scores turns each score back into a whole number with int().

An inner join keeps only the ids found in both tables: Ada, Cal and Dee, three rows, and with no gaps the scores stay whole numbers. Choose a left join when every pupil must appear in the report, an inner join when only complete rows are any use.

itertuples(index=False) gives each row as a tuple of plain Python values, which unpacks straight into pupil_id, name and score. A missing score is handed back as None, not NaN. The reason is equality: NaN is not equal to anything, not even to itself, while None == None is True - the last line of the demo prints False and then True. A list holding NaN never equals another list holding NaN, so any code that compares results, a test or a check for changes, would see a difference where there is none.

With an empty list of scores every pupil is still there, each with None - a left join never loses a row of the left table. The result is [(1, 'Ada', 72), (2, 'Ben', None), (3, 'Cal', 65), (4, 'Dee', 81)] for the full data.
zh: 数据常常分在两张共用一个键的表里：学生表有 id 和名字，分数表有 id 和分数。merge 按共有的那一列把行对齐，how 说留下哪些行。
左连接留下左表的每一行，顺序不变。Ada、Cal、Dee 有分数；Ben（id 2）没有，所以他的分数是 NaN。id 5 的分数对不上任何学生，被丢掉。因为 NaN 是浮点数，整列分数都变成浮点数——72.0、NaN、65.0、81.0——这就是 join_scores 要用 int() 把每个分数转回整数的原因。
内连接只留两张表都有的 id：Ada、Cal、Dee 三行；没有缺口，分数仍是整数。报表里每个学生都得出现时用左连接，只有完整的行才有用时用内连接。

itertuples(index=False) 把每一行给成一个由 Python 自己的值组成的元组，直接拆包成 pupil_id、name、score。缺的分数交回去时是 None，不是 NaN。原因在「相等」：NaN 不等于任何东西，连它自己都不等，而 None == None 为 True——演示块最后一行先打印 False、再打印 True。含 NaN 的列表永远不等于另一个含 NaN 的列表，所以任何比较结果的代码（测试，或者检查有没有变化）都会看到一个其实不存在的差别。
分数列表为空时，每个学生仍在，分数都是 None——左连接从不丢左表的行。完整的数据得到 [(1, 'Ada', 72), (2, 'Ben', None), (3, 'Cal', 65), (4, 'Dee', 81)]。

lineNotes.en: The demo calls merge as a pandas function, with both tables as arguments.
lineNotes.zh: 演示块把 merge 当作 pandas 的函数来调用，两张表都作实参。

lineNotes.at: for pupil_id, name, score in joined.itertuples(index=False):
lineNotes.en: Each row as a plain tuple, without its index label.
lineNotes.zh: 每一行给成普通元组，不带行标签。

lineNotes.en: int(): the score column became float when NaN appeared.
lineNotes.zh: int()：出现 NaN 之后，分数那一列成了浮点数。

lineNotes.en: NaN is not even equal to itself; None is.
lineNotes.zh: NaN 连自己都不等于；None 等于自己。

blurb.en: Sort by form, and within a form by score from high to low, each column in its own direction. Then see what stable means for ties, and take the top rows with nlargest.
blurb.zh: 先按班级排，同班再按分数从高到低，每一列各有各的方向。再看「稳定」对并列意味着什么，并用 nlargest 取前几名。

en: sort_values with a list of column names sorts by the first and uses the second only to break ties: here by form, and within a form by score. ascending takes a list of the same length, so each column gets its own direction - forms from 12A upwards, scores from high to low. The names come out Dee, Eve, Ben for 12A and then Cal, Ada, Fay for 12B.

Dee and Eve are both in 12A with 72. Rows that tie on every sort column keep the order they had before sorting: Dee comes before Eve in ROWS, so Dee comes first; sort the reversed list and Eve comes first. That is what a stable sort promises. When sorting by more than one column pandas always sorts this way and ignores kind, which is why the two-column sort does not set it.

Sorting by a single column is different: its default algorithm, quicksort, does not promise to keep ties in order, and kind="stable" asks for the promise. With these six rows the default happens to give the same order, only because the table is so small; with a long table it need not. Sorted by score alone, high to low: Cal 81, then the three 72s in their original order Ada, Dee, Eve, then Fay 64 and Ben 58. to_string(index=False) prints the table without the row labels.

nlargest(2, "score") takes the two rows with the largest scores, Cal and Ada, without sorting everything. Ada, Dee and Eve all have 72, so which of them is second? By default the one that comes first, Ada; keep="all" keeps every row tied with the last place, which gives four names. Sorting returns a new table: df itself is still in its original order, Ada to Fay.
Why stability matters, and sorting by a key without pandas, are on the 「Sorting」 page.
zh: sort_values 收一个列名列表时，按第一列排，第二列只用来分出并列：这里先按 form，同班再按 score。ascending 收一个同样长的列表，于是每一列各有各的方向——班级从 12A 往上，分数从高到低。名字排出来是 12A 的 Dee、Eve、Ben，然后是 12B 的 Cal、Ada、Fay。
Dee 和 Eve 都在 12A、都是 72 分。在所有排序列上都并列的行，保持排序前的先后：ROWS 里 Dee 在 Eve 前面，所以 Dee 在前；把列表倒过来再排，就是 Eve 在前。这就是「稳定排序」的承诺。按多列排序时，pandas 总是这样排，并且不理会 kind——所以两列排序那一行不写它。
只按一列排就不同了：默认的算法 quicksort 不保证并列的行保持先后，kind="stable" 就是要这个保证。这六行用默认算法恰好也排成同样的顺序，只是因为表太小；表长了就不一定。只按分数从高到低：Cal 81，然后三个 72 按原来的先后 Ada、Dee、Eve，再是 Fay 64、Ben 58。to_string(index=False) 打印表时不带行标签。
nlargest(2, "score") 取分数最大的两行，Cal 和 Ada，不用把整张表都排一遍。Ada、Dee、Eve 都是 72，第二名算谁？默认取排在前面的 Ada；keep="all" 把和最后一名并列的行全留下，得到四个名字。排序返回的是一张新表：df 自己仍是原来的顺序，从 Ada 到 Fay。
稳定性为什么要紧、不用 pandas 怎样按键排序，见「排序」页。

lineNotes.en: Same rows, reversed: the tie between Dee and Eve now comes out the other way round.
lineNotes.zh: 同样的行、倒过来：Dee 和 Eve 的并列这回反过来了。

lineNotes.en: keep="all": every row tied with second place stays.
lineNotes.zh: keep="all"：和第二名并列的行都留下。

lineNotes.en: df itself was never reordered.
lineNotes.zh: df 自己从没被重排过。
